import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    ans = 0
    # Precompute all multiples of 25 up to 10^8-1
    for i in range(0, 100000000, 25):
        test = str(i)
        if len(test) != len(s):
            continue
        works = True
        x_digit = -1
        for j in range(len(test)):
            sc = s[j]
            tc = test[j]
            if sc == 'X':
                if x_digit == -1:
                    x_digit = tc
                elif tc != x_digit:
                    works = False
                    break
            elif sc != '_' and sc != tc:
                works = False
                break
        if works:
            ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
